name: Rule34 DW Button
description: Adds a DW download button (and a Solo/Multi multi-select mode with Easy-select) to rule34.xxx thumbnails and post pages. Always downloads the highest-quality original (Original image/video — never .php). Multi-selection persists across pages, tabs, browser restarts, and successful downloads — only the red Снять выделение button clears it. Robust 429/403 retries with API fallback. Bulk downloads go silently to your Downloads folder.
author: play3r333
